query:
SELECT 
  feature, 
  action, 
  COUNT(*) as total_events,
  COUNT(DISTINCT userId) as unique_users,
  MIN(createdAt) as first_seen,
  MAX(createdAt) as last_seen
FROM feature_events
GROUP BY feature, action
ORDER BY total_events DESC
LIMIT 20;
